input: Read /config/template.env which has lines like 'KEY=${VALUE:-default}'. For each line, check if the key exists in /config/overrides.txt (format: KEY=value). If it does, use the override value; otherwise use the default from the template. Write the final KEY=value pairs to /app/.env and print the result.

transcript.final_response:
Wrote the final values to `/app/.env`:

```env
DB_HOST=db.prod.internal
DB_PORT=5432
DB_NAME=myapp
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
LOG_LEVEL=warn
```
tool_calls:
cat /config/template.env; printf '
--- overrides ---
'; cat /config/overrides.txt; printf '
--- status ---
'; ls -la /app /config

mkdir -p /app
bash <<'EOF'
declare -A overrides
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
  [[ -z $line ]] && continue
  key=${line%%=*}
  value=${line#*=}
  overrides["$key"]=$value
done < /config/overrides.txt
: > /app/.env
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
  [[ -z $line ]] && continue
  key=${line%%=*}
  expr=${line#*=}
  prefix='${'"$key"':-'
  if [[ $expr == "$prefix"*'}' ]]; then
    default=${expr#"$prefix"}
    default=${default%\}}
  else
    printf 'Invalid template line: %s\n' "$line" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ ${overrides[$key]+present} ]]; then
    value=${overrides[$key]}
  else
    value=$default
  fi
  printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$value" >> /app/.env
done < /config/template.env
cat /app/.env
EOF
